info.desc: "The Masterplan" is a compilation album by the English rock band Oasis, released on 2 November 1998 by Creation Records. It was the band’s final release through the label and consists of B-sides that had not previously appeared on an album. The album was initially intended for release in regions such as the United States and Japan, where the tracks had only been available on imported European singles. "The Masterplan" reached number 2 in the UK, where it was certified platinum, and number 51 in the United States. It also reached the Top 20 in various international charts and sold .

podcast.body: The band retroactively added a disclaimer on this album to clarify the true recording location of a track that they had previously misrepresented as a live gig in Glasgow. This correction aimed to disclose the actual origin of the recording, which was a soundcheck at a Sony convention. "But we did all up to it on the Master Plan album to say where it was from."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This 1998 compilation of Oasis songs promoted "Acquiesce" as its single. "When creation released the master plan, a 1998 compilation of Oasis songs today, it was promoted with Aquias as the single."
